name: heartbridge
description: HeartBridge: multilingual post-discharge co-pilot (Telegram agent + nurse dashboard)

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.check: npm test && npm run test:web && npm run build
